description: I am excited to announce the release of "Citizen's Voices," a collection of op-eds written by Tennesseans. This digital journal highlights personal stories and perspectives on the issues that matter most—from protecting our healthcare resources and defending parental rights to supporting our small businesses and general constituent care.
